issues.message: Headline is severely clipped at the right canvas edge: 'BUY ETFs COM' is visible but the remainder (likely 'COMMISSION FREE' or similar) runs off the canvas. The core value proposition is unreadable.
CTA label is clipped — only 'START' and a faint 'INV' ghost are visible; the full call-to-action (e.g. 'START INVESTING') runs off the right edge of the canvas.
CTA pill extends past the right canvas edge with zero padding, and the label inside the pill is truncated. Pill shape itself is cut off.
Because both the headline and CTA label are truncated, the intended reading hierarchy collapses — viewer cannot resolve the primary message or the action.
Variant is essentially identical to the source, including the same clipping problems — suggests no reflow was performed for the 1080x1080 target.

notes: Variant reproduces the source faithfully but inherits its clipping defects without any layout adaptation. Not shippable until headline and CTA are reflowed to fit within the 1080×1080 canvas with adequate edge padding.
